description: Provenance summary for the Weekend-2 teacher-labeling pass (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, 4-bit) over the full CORD+SROIE train splits. The actual per-sample labeled data lives in data/distill/*.jsonl (gitignored, regenerable via scripts/teacher_label.py) -- this file is the small, tracked record of how well that pass went, analogous to results/results.csv for eval runs.
compute: Kaggle free-tier NvidiaTeslaT4, chunked across 8 kernel runs (~200 samples each) to fit the per-session runtime cap
known_failure_modes_observed: one 22-line-item receipt produced truncated/invalid JSON, likely hitting the 512-token generation cap
at least one currency/magnitude error: a Thai receipt total misread as '40' instead of '40,000' (correct currency, 1000x scale error)
at least two observed cases of tax vs. subtotal confusion
caveat: agrees_with_gold_on_total is a cheap single-field proxy for teacher correctness (per scripts/teacher_label.py). It does not verify vendor, date, currency, or line_items independently -- an agreeing total does not guarantee the rest of the extraction is correct. This is exactly why the SFT blend-policy ablation (gold vs teacher vs teacher-agree) exists as a research question, not an assumption.
